headline: His Novel Had a Shot at a Top Book Prize. Then Someone Ran an A.I. Test.
context: “It Was Either That Or Die,” by the Haitian-Canadian author Thélyson Orélien, was the hit of the French literary season. Now it has been pulled from the shortlist for a prestigious prize.
